info.title: Demon God of the War Torn Land Goshogun (ITA)
info.synopsis: Nel 2001 l'umanità ha raggiunto traguardi impressionanti, riuscendo a spingersi nelle profondità spaziali. Questi progressi vengono improvvisamente oscurati da un'organizzazione criminale chiamata Veleno Nero, il cui scopo è dominare la Terra. Tuttavia vi è ancora una speranza che brilla contro di esso: si tratta di Goshogun, e della misteriosa energia Beamler.

info.title: The Fantastic Adventures Of Unico
info.synopsis: Il piccolo unicorno Unico vive con la sua padrona Psiche, donandole gioia e fortuna, in cambio del suo amore incondizionato. Ma la dea Venere, gelosa di Psiche, spedisce Unico in un viaggio attraverso lo spazio e il tempo. Quando si sveglia, si ritrova ad affrontare un bufalo nel West, senza più alcun ricordo di Psiche né del suo passato. Questa è solo una delle esaltanti avventure che porteranno Unico a fronteggiare l'alta società della Russia imperiale, personaggi delle favole e Shakespeariani, e persino uno stabilimento automatizzato determinato a cancellare il sole!

info.title: Witch Watch
info.synopsis: La famiglia di Morihito Otogi discende da una lunga stirpe di orchi che possiedono una forza sovraumana. Un giorno il padre arriva a casa con una notizia che gli cambierà la vita: diventerà il famiglio della sua amica d'infanzia Nico, una strega. I due ragazzi dovranno convivere insieme e Morihito dovrà proteggerla da chiunque voglia farle del male. Dall'altro lato Nico è emozionata di poter vivere con l'amore della sua vita, anche se è una cosa unilaterale... infatti il ragazzo è così ottuso e serio riguardo la missione da rendere impossibile qualsiasi storia d'amore. Ma Morihito ha tutte le ragioni per comportarsi così, visto che una profezia di sventura pende sulla testa di Nico!

episodes.title: Witch`s Return
episodes.synopsis: Ogre descendant Morihito begins living with his childhood friend Nico, a novice witch, but he soon has his hands full keeping her out of trouble.

episodes.title: A Giant Rookie / Let`s Go to a Diner / The Flying Classroom
episodes.synopsis: On the first day of school, Morihito urges Nico to hide the fact that she’s a witch, but she tries using magic to secretly help him out in class.

episodes.title: Fresh Transparent Fashions for Spring / Witch`s Delivery Service / Lost Dogs and the Patter of Rain
episodes.synopsis: Nico’s mother sends Morihito a letter containing a worrying prophecy. Unable to decipher the meaning, Morihito spends the rest of the day on his toes.

episodes.title: Kanshi Kazamatsuri, the Tengu
episodes.synopsis: Kanshi explains that Nico’s mother sent him to protect her. He and Morihito clash, but he takes a moment to warn him of an enemy within the school.

episodes.title: My Student Is My Favorite Fan Artist / My Tummy Is Tender Today / Cat Scout
episodes.synopsis: Closet manga fan Ms. Makuwa loses her composure when she realizes that one of her students is a popular fan artist for her favorite series.

episodes.title: Under the Lovers` Tree
episodes.synopsis: After realizing Morihito is getting popular with the girls at school, Nico learns of a so-called lovers’ tree near the site of an upcoming field trip.

episodes.title: Kan and Nico`s Channel / The Tea Ceremony Is a Piece of Tea Cake
episodes.synopsis: Nico and Kanshi start an online video channel, but Morihito is annoyed by their lack of originality and asks their hipster classmate Magami for help.

episodes.title: Kanshi`s Part-Time Job Diaries: The Superhero Show / Kanshi`s Part-Time Job Diaries: The Side Job
episodes.synopsis: When Kanshi can’t pay his share of the living expenses, Morihito hands him a flyer from an amusement park hiring performers for a superhero show.

episodes.title: Dear Kara / New Friend / Date with the Knight
episodes.synopsis: Nico and Morihito’s classmate Kara asks them to restore a letter from her deceased mother, which her father put through a paper shredder.

episodes.title: Trope-tacular Student Council / A Stray Cat`s Bubble of Bliss
episodes.synopsis: After a student council vice president makes a dramatic entrance to forbid Nico from using magic, the council’s other larger-than-life members arrive.

episodes.title: Dogs and Raindrops, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Kanshi saves Keigo from a bully who claims to be using a candy with a stimulant effect. A self-proclaimed witch appears before Nico and Morihito.

episodes.title: Dogs and Raindrops, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: A transformed Keigo attacks the isolated Morihito. Surrounded by Wolf's “Dogs,” Kanshi and Nico devise a plan to locate and neutralize the warlock.

episodes.title: Keigo Magami, the Werewolf / Kind Tiger, Proud Wolf / Easy Spices for Enthralling Cooking
episodes.synopsis: Morihito and the others decide to get rid of any crescent-shaped objects to minimize the risk of Keigo transforming into a werewolf in the house.

episodes.title: Uron Mirage Chapter 119: The Phasey Hunt, Part 4 / Diary of My Favorite Artist
episodes.synopsis: In Episode 119 of Uron Mirage, swordsmen Utsuro, Oboro, Sagiri and Zack decide to split up and search the buildings of an abandoned research facility.

episodes.title: Summer Demon
episodes.synopsis: Ibuki’s newest prophecy advises seeking a family that dispels evil. Nico and her friends set out in search, treating the journey like a summer trip.

episodes.title: Miharu Kiryu, the Vampire / Missing Parasol / I`m So Glad You`re Here
episodes.synopsis: Vampire Miharu moves into the Otogi house, but as a night person with different energy needs, he may struggle to adjust to communal living.

episodes.title: We Got Trapped in a Death Game, but It Sucked / Long Long a Go Go
episodes.synopsis: Morihito and the other guys awake in an unknown place. A mysterious figure tells them they must play a game — and that Nico is being held hostage.

episodes.title: Kara and Shiki / Mega Marble Mania Madness / Scramble Scrap Squad
episodes.synopsis: Nico and Kukumi help Kara out at the shrine run by her father. When Nico casts a spell to make a paper cat move around, Kara gets an idea.

episodes.title: Letter from a Friend
episodes.synopsis: When tidying the house, Morihito finds a letter Nico wrote to him when they were kids. Nico shares her memories of those days with Nemu and the guys.

episodes.title: The Lost Wolf and the Stray Cat
episodes.synopsis: Noticing that Keigo seems sad, Nico gives him a ring imbued with a levitation spell. As he secretly trains to use it, Nemu approaches him.

episodes.title: Secret Urges / Keiko`s Carefree Style / Jekyll Visits the Otogi House
episodes.synopsis: As Keigo wonders why his channel isn't getting more views, Nico casts a spell on him that she believes will help make his videos more interesting.

episodes.title: The Incredible Shrinking Adventure / The Hamazaki Fall Bread Festival / Lucky Birthday
episodes.synopsis: While sharing donuts with Kara and Morihito, Nico decides to shrink herself and Morihito down so they can experience eating a giant pastry.

episodes.title: Our First Offline Meetup / Fave Artist File: Creative Surge / Fave Artist File: Crazy Event Arc
episodes.synopsis: When Kukumi mentions that she will be meeting a friend from social media in person for the first time, a worried Ms. Makuwa decides to tail her.

episodes.title: Moi`s Denim Devotion / Date with the Guide
episodes.synopsis: When Morihito declares it's time to give his favorite pair of jeans a second wash, Miharu asks to know more about denim — much to the others' chagrin.

episodes.title: Freshman Witch and Her Familiars
episodes.synopsis: It’s almost Asunaro Festival. Nico’s class will be utilizing her magic to run a “haunted café” so you can spend some whimsical time in a cafe full of ghosts. While the class was preparing for the event, Nico was asked by a festival committee member if she could cast some spells during the festival’s opening ceremony. Meanwhile, Kanshi asks Morihito to do a comedy duo on the performance stage.

info.title: Ozma
info.synopsis: L’anime è ambientato nel futuro allorquando un’anomalia del sole devasta l’atmosfera terrestre, danneggiandone irreparabilmente l’ecosistema. La terra diventa una landa desertica, conseguentemente al mutamento climatico, il DNA umano si è deteriorato, tanto da rendere molto difficoltose nuove nascite; per perpetrare la specie, il governo è costretto a creare dei cloni denominati "IC" (Ideal Children) e un nuovo organo di governo e controllo per gli IC. Sam Coin, un “pirata della sabbia” che commercia in questo mare desertico, è alla ricerca di "Ozma", un gigantesco oggetto non identificato, che ha attaccato il fratello. Nel suo peregrinare Sam salva una bella ragazza di nome Maya, inseguita dalla Shishiasu, un vascello dell’esercito IC. Il giovane uomo decide di portare con se la ragazza alla nave pirata Barudanosu, presso il porto di Oaaze; tuttavia la Barudanosu è assediata dagli IC…

episodes.title: The Sand Whale
episodes.synopsis: Sam is searching for an ozuma, or sand whale, when he spots a woman being chased by the Theseus Army. When an ozuma appears and causes the military to turn back, Sam rescues the woman, who introduces herself as Maya. Sam takes Maya back to the ship he lives on to let her eat, but the Theseus Army catches up and corners the ship, demanding Maya. The captain decides to protect Maya, and the military opens fire. The ship escapes by diving into the desert sand, much to the surprise of the Theseus commander.

episodes.title: Underground Voyage
episodes.synopsis: Diving Limits The Sand Pirates have escaped with Maya, and Theseus is in hot pursuit. The pirates dive under the sand, but are locked down by sand anchors. The pressure and temperature in the ship are rising, and time is running out.

episodes.title: A Thousand Years of Doubt
episodes.synopsis: Sam takes Maya to a hidden shelter constructed in the distant past, and filled with ancient technology. This shelter is the source of the ship's technology, and the secret of Sam's plans to hunt the sand whale.

episodes.title: To the Ends of the Earth
episodes.synopsis: To the Ends of the Earth : As Gido escapes with Maya, Sam sets off in pursuit with Mimay in tow. But their bike is no match for the Theseus sand cruiser, and Gido escapes. To catch them, they'll have to go back under the ground with the Bardanos.

episodes.title: The Masked Man
episodes.synopsis: The Bardanos finds itself in Ozma's nest: a strange cave filled with fresh water and life. Bainas shoots Gido's mask, and the face beneath it is that of Sam's brother.

episodes.title: The Day of New Life
episodes.synopsis: Ozma's nature is revealed, and it's time for Maya to make her choice: begin a new era with the life inside the zone, or allow humanity to remain in control of a dying planet.

info.title: Hoshizora Kiseki
info.synopsis: Kozue, una studentessa membro del club di astronomia, sente una voce che la chiama, ed è convinta che in un certo posto cadrà una stella. A tal proposito cerca di organizzare una gita coinvolgendo gli altri membri del club, ma con scarsi risultati. Noncurante di ciò si reca da sola in quel posto e incontra un ragazzo con una tuta da astronauta, che si trova lì per svolgere una qualche operazione segreta.per conto di qualcuno.

info.title: Metal Skin Panic MADOX-01
info.synopsis: Durante il primo test di una rivoluzionaria armatura da combattimento, la MADOX-01, la pilota collaudatrice Ellie Kusomoto distrugge una truppa di carri armati e umilia il tenente Kilgore, il carrista più forte del Giappone. Kilgore giura di vendicarsi e ne ha l'occasione quando il prototipo MADOX cade letteralmente dal retro di un camion nel centro di Tokyo. Nel frattempo, il MADOX, è finito nelle mani dello studente universitario Kōji Sujimoto. Incuriosito dal MADOX, Kōji commette il grande errore di usarlo senza aver letto bene il manuale e si ritrova bloccato nell'armatura e a girare per il centro di Tokyo.

episodes.title: Pilota
episodes.synopsis: Leonard e Sheldon, due ricercatori di un istituto di fisica universitario dall'elevato QI, fanno conoscenza di Penny, la loro nuova vicina di casa che ha appena traslocato. Gentile e molto carina, la ragazza conquista subito il cuore di Leonard che è subito disposto a tutto pur di renderle meno faticoso il primo giorno nel nuovo appartamento nonostante lo scetticismo di Sheldon e degli altri due loro amici ricercatori Howard e Rajesh, tutti convinti che un nerd mai e poi mai potrà avere una relazione sentimentale con una ragazza come Penny.

info.title: Continuavano a chiamarlo il gatto con gli stivali
info.synopsis: Pero è diretto nell'assolato villaggio del west GoGo Town insieme a due ragazzi, Jimmy e Annie. Annie viene a conoscenza che suo padre aveva scoperto una zecca clandestina, ma il capo dei falsari, il losco Santana, la rapisce. Così Pero, alleatosi con una tribù di topi pellirosse, aiuta Jimmy ad affrontare Santana e i suoi scagnozzi.

info.title: Plus-sized Misadventures in Love!
info.synopsis: Yumeko è una ragazza piena di complessi che dopo un grave incidente si risveglia con una personalità completamente diversa. Tutti quelli che la circondano non riescono a nascondere lo stupore per questo cambiamento repentino. ma il nuovo atteggiamento iperpositivo di Yumeko inizierà a influenzare i suoi conoscenti. Preoccupazioni e complessi possono colpire chiunque. ma questa ragazza è decisa a fare a pezzi qualsiasi problema... che sia di lavoro, d'amore, d'amicizia o perfino un tentato omicidio!

episodes.title: Positive Thinking!
episodes.synopsis: When Yumeko wakes up in a hospital, she learns that she's lost her memory and gained a brand new personality.

episodes.title: The Man from the Park and Vice President
episodes.synopsis: Yumeko must give her first presentation at work, but her idea notebooks go missing.

episodes.title: The Old Me
episodes.synopsis: As police investigate her accident, Yumeko begins suffering from unsettling flashbacks of her past.

episodes.title: Charm Point
episodes.synopsis: Yumeko and Maezono navigate a tricky a business trip, and Shigemori confronts his workplace crush.

episodes.title: No Such Thing as a Bad Kid
episodes.synopsis: Yumeko is thrilled by Keisuke's dinner invite, but a mysterious child dampens her excitement.

episodes.title: Yumeko and Her Mom`s Relationship
episodes.synopsis: As Minami’s investigation deepens, Yumeko decides to revisit past relationships in search of answers.

episodes.title: The Only One in the World
episodes.synopsis: Yumeko meets the package designer for her product and learns more about Keisuke and Maezono's past.

episodes.title: Kindness Comes with a Cold
episodes.synopsis: Yumeko rushes to complete tasks at work, and just when she makes plans to meet Keisuke, she catches a cold.

episodes.title: The Person He Loves?
episodes.synopsis: Yumeko decides on a thank you gift for Yuki, only to witness him entering a hotel with Rikako.

episodes.title: Minami Wants to Die
episodes.synopsis: Detective Minami takes a rare day off from work, and Yumeko and Tanigawa learn of his past.

episodes.title: The Grill-Out of Joy and Suspense
episodes.synopsis: Yumeko's Ramune Chips turns out to be a hit, and Yuki plans a grill-out to celebrate her team's success.

episodes.title: Your Smile Is My Happiness
episodes.synopsis: As Degawa urges Yumeko to confront Rikako, the two run into Maezono. Meanwhile, Yuki and Rikako return home.

info.title: The Legend of Princess Chang-Ge
info.synopsis: Dopo l’Incidente della Porta di Xuanwu, il principe Li Jiancheng e la sua famiglia furono quasi completamente eliminati dalla storia ufficiale. Tra le poche figure sopravvissute nei registri emerge Li Changge, che, segnata dalla morte dei genitori, fugge dal palazzo, si traveste da uomo e cerca vendetta contro Li Shimin tornando a Chang’an con un esercito.

Yui has been restraining herself lately, but Tsuyoshi pushes her down, overcome by jealousy when she talks about her husband.

info.title: La fortuna di Nikuko
info.synopsis: Kikuko, detta anche Kikurin, ha 11 anni e vive con sua madre, Nikuko. Nikuko ha 38 anni, non è molto piacente, è poco sveglia, chiassosa e anche grassa. Non ha un gran fiuto per gli uomini e quando l'ennesimo partner la lascia, la donna decide di andare a cercarlo in un paesino del nord. Dopo essersi resa conto che probabilmente è finita nel posto sbagliato, decide comunque che si stabiliranno in questa piccola località portuale, e trova lavoro in un ristorante. Kikurin, come tipico della sua età, è combattuta tra il desiderio di voler crescere in fretta e il voler restare bambina. Il suo aspetto attuale le piace ma allo stesso tempo sogna di poter presto andare via da quel posto in cui tutti conoscono tutto di tutti. Attraverso i suoi occhi, conosciamo i vari abitanti del paese, suoi coetanei ma anche adulti, e seguiamo il suo percorso di crescita.

info.title: Akane-banashi (ITA)
info.synopsis: Il rakugo è un genere teatrale giapponese nel quale un narratore racconta mediante un monologo, ma anche tramite le proprie movenze ed espressioni, delle storie capaci di ipnotizzare gli spettatori. Shinta e sua figlia Akane sono stati conquistati da questa forma di arte così espressiva. La ragazza dopo aver trascorso anni osservando il padre decide che è giunto il suo momento, ma imporsi in questo mondo scintillante non sarà facile.

episodes.title: That Day
episodes.synopsis:
Akane Osaki, a fifth-grade student, captivated by the magical Rakugo performance of her father, Shinta Arakawa.
Determined to support the family who have always stood behind his dream, Shinta takes on the promotion exam to achieve the highest rank in the Rakugo world—Shin’uchi. 
As Akane and the others look on, Shinta delivers a performance that showcases his true skill. However, the exam takes a shocking and completely unexpected turn that no one could have foreseen.

episodes.title: First Performance
episodes.synopsis:
Guriko Arakawa, a fledgling Futatsume (the second-highest rank Rakugo performer), begins investigating a rumor that his master, Shiguma Arakawa, has been secretly meeting a young woman.
What he discovers, however, is Akane, now a high school student, receiving private Rakugo lessons from Shiguma at a karaoke box.
Around that time, Shiguma receives word that a performer is urgently needed to fill a slot at an event at “Rakugo Cafe.”
Yet instead of choosing the more experienced Guriko, Shiguma unexpectedly nominates Akane.

episodes.title: Senior Apprentices
episodes.synopsis:
After performing for the first time and being motivated by Kaisei Arakawa's Rakugo performance, Akane is officially accepted as Shiguma's apprentice. He introduces her to her unique senior apprentices and the disciplined Kyoji Arakawa takes her under his wing.
Akane is sure that she’ll get to hone her artistic Rakugo skills, but all Kyoji orders her to do is menial tasks.
On top of that, he sends her to train at the most unexpected place…

episodes.title: Beyond Joy
episodes.synopsis:
During her training at the Izakaya “Umi”, Akane learns the art of “attentiveness”. Kyoji takes her to his next job at a retirement home, where Rakugo is the recreational event of the day.
Determined to make sure her elderly audience members enjoy themselves, Akane shows off the results of her training on stage. Following her, Kyoji takes the stage, determined to show her the dignity and authority as her senior apprentice.

episodes.title: Her Path Forward
episodes.synopsis:
Now that midterms are over, senior high schooler Akane, can finally breathe a sigh of relief—but only for a fleeting moment. She is soon called in for a career counseling session with her homeroom teacher, Ms. Iwashimizu, a.k.a. the “Ice Lady.”
Though Akane's set on becoming a Rakugoka, Iwashimizu is insistent that she instead go to college, a more realistic goal. Desperate to win her over, Akane turns to her friends for advice on how to change her mind...

episodes.title: Terakoya
episodes.synopsis: The Karaku Cup is a Rakugo contest for students. When Akane learns that Issho Arakawa will be presiding as its chief judge, she asks Shiguma for permission to enter. He gives her one condition: To win with "Jugemu". It's a tall order for her to try to win with such a well-known story, so along with Guriko, Akane turns to Koguma Arakawa, the "Terakoya," a grassroots teacher of the Shiguma School, for advice. Koguma's a walking encyclopedia of Rakugo, but...

episodes.title: Karaku Cup
episodes.synopsis: It's the day of the Karaku Cup preliminary round. This year, all eyes are on the defending two-time champion, Karashi Nerimaya, and a rising young voice actress, Hikaru Koragi. But Kaisei, the emcee of the event, has told a reporter that his money is on Akane, an unknown high school student, to win it all. At the venue, Koguma, Guriko, and Ms. Iwashimizu are ready to watch over Akane from their seats. Facing such stiff competition, can Akane advance past the prelims with "Jugemu"?

episodes.title: What They Want
episodes.synopsis:
The Karaku Cup finals are now underway. The chief judge, Issho Arakawa, has taken his place at the venue. Following a stream of performances, it's time for one of the frontrunners, Karashi Nerimaya, to take the stage. Karashi's specialty is "Modernized Rakugo", 
— modern interpretations of classic Rakugo stories. This bold approach gets him some big laughs from the audience, but what will Issho's verdict be?

episodes.title: Expressionist
episodes.synopsis:
The Karaku Cup final continues. Following Karashi, voice actress Hikaru Koragi takes the stage.
Determined to be judged not for her looks, but for her acting skills, she competes in the Karaku Cup.
To showcase her expressiveness, she performs a sentimental story.
Coincidentally, it's "Shibahama" - the story
that Shinta performed during his Shin'uchi Promotion Test six years ago. Hikaru's passionate performance rocks the audience, and in its wake, Akane takes the stage at last.

episodes.title: Jugemu
episodes.synopsis: In contrast to her performance in the prelims, where she put her enunciation skills on full display, Akane delivers "Jugemu" in a relatively relaxed manner during the finals. Karashi and Hikaru suspect that she's throwing the match, but in fact, she's taken a true Rakugoka's approach - bringing the audience down from the high of the previous sets into a comfortable lull. As she leans into her characters' emotions, effortlessly enthralling her listeners with her gentle tone, Akane gradually reaches a new level in her performance.

episodes.title: Answer
episodes.synopsis:
Face to face with Issho Arakawa, Akane asks him point-blank why he had expelled Shinta.
After he sends the journalists out of the room, Issho informs her that he can see right through the fact that Akane is training under Shiguma. As Akane flinches, he reveals the truth behind the expulsion six years ago- the truth he has never shared before. Now that she's finally learned the reason behind her father's expulsion, what could be going through Akane's mind?

episodes.title: Graduation
episodes.synopsis:
After winning the Karaku Cup, Akane suddenly finds herself in the spotlight at school. 
But unconvinced that her performance was good enough to blow Issho away, she has mixed feelings about it all. And now, graduation day is approaching. Motivated by Akane’s success, her friends have started to pursue their own dreams. Meanwhile, Shiguma racks his brain, trying to come up with a stage name for Akane, who’ll officially become his apprentice once she graduates. And as her thoughts turn to her father, Shinta, Akane ponders the meaning of her own given name.

info.title: Chainsmoker Cat (ITA)
info.synopsis: In un Giappone moderno dove umani e neko (esseri umanoidi con caratteristiche feline) convivono, vive Yaniko Satō, una catgirl poco ordinaria: pigra, disordinata, incapace di gestire la propria vita… e gravemente dipendente dalle sigarette. Yaniko non può fare a meno di fumare, a tal punto che il suo appartamento puzza di fumo, è pieno di mozziconi e rifiuti, e ogni volta che tenta di smettere cade vittima delle sue enormi voglie. I suoi soldi vanno quasi tutti nell’acquisto di nuove sigarette, e quando non può permettersele comincia a recuperare mozziconi per strada o a riutilizzarli pur di soddisfare il bisogno di nicotina. Costantemente in ritardo con l’affitto e incapace di mantenere un lavoro, Yaniko si trova spesso in situazioni assurde e grottesche. La sua sorella, i suoi amici e i vicini di casa cercano di aiutarla mentre lei combina guai dopo guai, affrontando piccoli drammi quotidiani con ironia e disordine.

episodes.title: I`m a Chainsmoker Cat, Nya
episodes.synopsis: Catgirl Yani struggles to pay rent and spends what little she has on cigarettes — until an urgent text from her sister Imoko sparks a far greater crisis.

episodes.title: Meet My Juniors, Nya
episodes.synopsis: Yani wants to continue her carefree life, but she receives a job offer as financial pressure builds. Will she commit to this opportunity or her freedom?

episodes.title: I`m More Straight Than Funny, Nya
episodes.synopsis: After another clash with her landlord, Yani agrees to tend his garden to cover her rent. It seems like a perfect fix — until she faces his cabbage patch.

episodes.title: Freaks All Around Me, Nya
episodes.synopsis: Yani lands a job assisting Saori Tatsuro, a risque manga artist. After Yani mistakenly burns her manuscript, an unexpected police visit follows.

episodes.title: We`re Off to a Secret Place, Nya
episodes.synopsis: Despite her sister's attempts to take away her cigarettes, Yani refuses to quit. At the same time, Imoko navigates a youthful romance.

episodes.title: Summer Starts and Ends Here, Nya
episodes.synopsis: Yani's fellow tenant Aruko disappears during a drinking party while three new assistants arrive at Tatsuro's workplace as her deadline looms closer.

episodes.title: I Was Born to Parents Too, Nya
episodes.synopsis: Yani takes a cleaning job at a shady underground facility. Meanwhile, her landlord welcomes a new houseguest, quickly followed by an unexpected mishap.

episodes.title: Even We Run Around in December, Nya
episodes.synopsis: Yani expects a lonely birthday, unaware that Imoko is planning a surprise party for her. Elsewhere, Yani's landlord becomes trapped in a foul time loop.

episodes.title: My Little Sis Is Popular, Nya
episodes.synopsis: Yani's peculiar toilet habits spark chaos around her while Imoko receives a gift from a secret admirer who turns out to be anything but ordinary.

episodes.title: I`m Gonnya Enjoy the Outing Too, Nya
episodes.synopsis: Yani's neighbors Yakuneko and Hameneko head to a mystical waterfall — but Hameneko's selfishness drives Yakuneko to hatch a wild revenge plan.

episodes.title: We`re in Kyoto, Nya
episodes.synopsis: Yani and her flatmates set off on a Kyoto and Nara getaway — but her antics lead to an encounter with the "King of Deer," a creature of ancient wisdom.

episodes.title: I`m Gonnya Smoke Even in the Last Episode, Nya
episodes.synopsis: As her issues push the other residents to the edge, a worn-out Yani lashes out at her landlord — triggering the biggest brawl in the building's history.

episodes.title: STEEL BALL RUN
episodes.synopsis: Dopo un fatidico incontro con il fuorilegge Gyro Zeppeli, l'ex prodigio delle corse Johnny Joestar partecipa alla Steel Ball Run, la prima corsa di cavalli attraverso l'America.

episodes.title: La richiesta dello sceriffo per Mountain Tim
episodes.synopsis: Misteriosi omicidi si susseguono dopo il sorprendente epilogo della prima tappa. Il leggendario cowboy Mountain Tim entra in scena per indagare all'inizio della seconda tappa.

episodes.title: I Banditi Del Deserto
episodes.synopsis: Al campo, Johnny intravede uno scorcio del passato di Gyro. La famiglia Boomboom entra in azione con un potere ultraterreno, ma i due riescono a fuggire... o almeno così credono.

episodes.title: Devil's Palm
episodes.synopsis: Intrappolati dai Boomboom, Johnny, Gyro e Mountain Tim rischiano di essere distrutti da una forza magnetica. Poi scoprono l'esistenza degli "Stand" e il corpo di Johnny reagisce.

episodes.title: Il Dinamitardo Da Un Paese Lontano Lontano
episodes.synopsis: A un posto di blocco, il duo si trova davanti a un uomo di nome Oye che conosce il passato di Gyro e può trasformare in bomba qualsiasi cosa tocchi, lasciandoli senza scampo.
